items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: I had been with Roy in The Three Deuces. See after it was my band first. Zutty and his band. See, then Roy came in because Roy was in town with Fletcher Henderson and he used to come down and sit in and everything.

ctx.x: Yes. And Art Tatum had taken the band over and I had been with Roy in The Three Deuces. See after it was my band first. Zutty and his band. See, then Roy came in because Roy was in town with Fletcher Henderson and he used to come down and sit in and everything. And finally, they had (break in?) from the Chicago River. And we came to work one night and the dance floor was floating. See, and so right after that we reopened and that's when (Sam Day?) hired Roy Eldridge.
